Name: FishCraft
Overview:
FishCraft is a ballistics game heavily inspired by Finnish casual game Angry Birds. The fish are out to seek revenge on the cats for eating their friends and family. The way to accomplish this is by means of firing themselves at the cats (who have built fortresses to protect themselves) with a cannon.

Gameplay consists of the player adjusting a cannon (power and aim) towards the cat fortresses and fire various fishes at it, with the goal of eliminating all cats before running out of fish. The game is physics based, which means that hitting the fortress in certain weak points will make it collapse over the unknowing cats. There are several different types of fish with different properties (one, for example, can be made to explode on impact causing major damage), and each stage has a set number of various fish. The trick is to figure out how to utilize them best to finish the stage with a high score.

Stages unlock as the player finishes them, and there are 63 all together. For each finished stage, the player receives a star rating showing how well he/she did.
